title: Navigate slides within deck boundaries and keep position and anchor in sync
preconditions: Implementation fixture has Request flow with Request enters and Response returns, and a separate one-slide Failure path deck.

steps.expected_result: Response returns displays at 2 / 2 and Next is disabled.
Failure path displays at 1 / 1; Previous and Next are disabled.

steps.action: Return to Request flow, select its second slide and choose Previous; inspect each transition URL.
steps.expected_result: Request enters displays at 1 / 2, Previous is disabled, and each URL anchor names the active slide without entering another deck.
